item.title: Old Songs - Amy Jeffs, Gwen Burns, Natalie Brice
item.description: Best-selling historian and author Amy Jeffs, musician Natalie Brice, and illustrator Gwen Burns have created Old Songs, a reimagining of ten traditional British ballads in book and audio book form. The collaboration combines captivating words, music and illustration, and these stories, often with a supernatural element, certainly stay bouncing around the walls of the mind.
